scope: Actual application scripts, real React state/events, real bundled master JSON, synthetic 91-day demo. Filesystem fetch and mocked AI only.
limitations: No visual layout or device camera/barcode verification
No real AI response quality or Vercel configuration verification
No actual service-worker update lifecycle or cross-tab browser navigation

checks.name: Entire app mounts with 91-day demo and isolated personal records
Day confirmation precedes overview and meal rows show Info and quantity actions
Info opens real nutrient details; quantity edit changes diary without changing archive
Recent foods are exactly three; last recorded quantity is reused and undo works
Global food query shows 20 results and pagination; ordinary amounts stay blank
Navigation mounts every section; Altro excludes duplicate primary pages and planner route
Quality analytics render week/month/year with real computed series and coverage
Objectives preserve manual controls and show a standalone journey entry
Coach local capabilities, pantry and shopping work while cloud consent is off
Coach pantry quantity review performs a real save and undo
Coach search resolves an actual master food and confirmed double click writes once
Coach creates shopping from real recipe and exposes computed missing grams
Actual chat executes bounded two-step tool flow, creates review, then applies menu once
Coach speech pause and resume retain the existing TTS behavior
Pregnancy policy blocks local automatic menu even without health sharing
All demo edits leave personal diary, profile and consent byte-identical
